scripts.db:migrate:d1: for f in src/lib/db/drizzle/*.sql; do npx wrangler d1 execute presensi_db --file="$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.db:migrate:d1:remote: for f in src/lib/db/drizzle/*.sql; do npx wrangler d1 execute presensi_db --remote --file="$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.db:seed:d1: npm run db:export:d1 && npx wrangler d1 execute presensi_db --file=seed-d1.sql
scripts.db:seed:d1:remote: npm run db:export:d1 && npx wrangler d1 execute presensi_db --remote --file=seed-d1.sql
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: ADAPTER=cloudflare vite build && npx wrangler deploy
